## IQueueSchema type

Schema class constraint for [LmdbQueue](./lmdb.lmdbqueue.md) — a structural check, not a base class.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IQueueSchema = typeof LmdbSchema & {
    key: IColumnBuilder<`string`>;
};
```
**References:** [LmdbSchema](./lmdb.lmdbschema.md)<!-- -->, [IColumnBuilder](./lmdb.icolumnbuilder.md)

## Remarks

The queue generates zero-padded string ids, so the key must be string-kind: plain `t.string()` or a string enum (`t.string('a', 'b')`<!-- -->, `t.enum('a', 'b')`<!-- -->) — both satisfy `ColumnBuilder<'string'>` since literals ride the `V` generic. Pass your own schema class; do not extend this type. The one `as KeyOf<S>` per method bridges the generated `string` id to the generic key.
